arguments:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$taskName = 'Codex_Open_Cinebench2026_20260904T1515'
$target = 'C:\Assets\Cinebench2026'
$user = 'DESKTOP-5OJC3K4\Song'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $target -PathType Container)) { throw ('Target directory not found: ' + $target) }
$action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'C:\Windows\explorer.exe' -Argument $target
$principal = New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId $user -LogonType Interactive -RunLevel Limited
$settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -ExecutionTimeLimit (New-TimeSpan -Minutes 5) -AllowStartIfOnBatteries -DontStopIfGoingOnBatteries
try {
 Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $taskName -Action $action -Principal $principal -Settings $settings -Force | Out-Null
 Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName $taskName
 Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
 $info = Get-ScheduledTaskInfo -TaskName $taskName
 [pscustomobject]@{OpenedPath=$target;InteractiveUser=$user;LastRunTime=$info.LastRunTime;LastTaskResult=$info.LastTaskResult;TaskState=(Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $taskName).State} | Format-List
} finally {
 Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName $taskName -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
